description: Arm (or disarm) a tenant vault: returns the EXACT EIP-712 VaultArm to sign with the vault owner's wallet (domain Taifoon Vault v1, no chainId; policy = the vault's policy_hash; nonce = the stored arm nonce + 1; expires = now + days, 1 to 30), the POST /v1/vault/arm body to send with the signature, and the cockpit link where the owner signs it with one click. This tool never signs: only the vault's current owner can arm it, and while the owner is not linked (owner_key pending) nobody can.

armed.description: true arms (default), false disarms (always honoured, no expiry rule)

days.description: how long the arm lasts (default 7, at most 30)

name: taifoon_vault_arm
